scoring_justification: N(EF) is recomputed from dos.csv; band structure saddle point is re-derived from submitted energies; frozen-phonon shifts are verified for sign and minimum magnitude.

outputs.description: Total density of states (DOS) for Y2Br2C2. Energy is relative to Fermi level (EF=0).
Band structure along Γ–A–M–Z–Γ path. Checks for existence of a saddle point near EF at Γ.
Energy shift of the C2-π* band at Gamma for elongation and rotation distortions. Sign and magnitude are verified.

output_contract.notes: The agent must install and use the Questaal TB-LMTO-ASA package. The equilibrium LMTO serves as the process step; only the three derived data artifacts are scored.

steps.description: Compute N(EF) as the DOS value at the Fermi energy (EF=0) and check it is within 0.2 eV⁻¹ spin⁻¹ of 1.0.
Verify that near the Gamma point there is a band with a saddle point (positive curvature along Γ–A and negative curvature along Γ–Z) within an energy window around EF.
Check that elongation shift is negative, rotation shift is positive, and both absolute shifts are at least 0.2 eV.
